requirements.title: CCPA applicability determination: Shadam LLC as a 'business'
requirements.amendment_notes: CCPA as amended by CPRA (Prop. 24), operative 2023-01-01; CPPA regulations at 11 CCR 7000 et seq., updated by the package approved by OAL in Sept. 2025 and effective 2026-01-01 (per secondary sources).

criteria: For-profit entity doing business in California that collects consumers' personal information and determines purposes and means of processing
thresholds: Annual gross revenue above $26,625,000 in the preceding calendar year (CPI-adjusted from $25,000,000 effective 2025-01-01 per CPPA announcement; verify in official text and any 2027 adjustment)
Alone or in combination, annually buys, sells, or shares personal information of 100,000 or more consumers or households
Derives 50% or more of annual revenue from selling or sharing consumers' personal information
exceptions: Not a business if no threshold met (other California laws still apply)
The B2B and employee partial exemptions expired 2023-01-01; B2B contacts and workforce data count as consumers' PI

required_behavior: Each January, document whether Shadam LLC met any 'business' threshold for the preceding calendar year, using its own revenue and consumer counts (including B2B contacts, employees and applicants who are California residents, and website visitors).
Record the CPI-adjusted revenue figure used, its source, and the date checked; re-check after each odd-year CPPA adjustment (next expected January 2027).
If no threshold is met, record that Shadam is not a CCPA 'business' for its own processing, and still apply CalOPPA (CA-002) and Civ 1798.81.5 (CA-003).

Count consumers whose personal information Shadam processes on behalf of tenants separately from consumers it processes for its own purposes; tenant-customer data processed as a service provider/contractor does not by itself make Shadam a business, but data it uses for its own purposes does.
requirements.enforcement_exposure: Administrative fines by CPPA / civil penalties by AG under Civ 1798.155 and 1798.199.90 (base amounts CPI-adjusted every odd-numbered year; 2025 adjustment reported by CPPA). No private right of action except data breaches (1798.150).
required_evidence: Annual signed CCPA applicability memo with revenue figure, consumer/household count method, and selling/sharing revenue share

The $26,625,000 figure is corroborated by search results pointing to the CPPA announcement of 2024-12-17 (cppa.ca.gov/announcements/2024/20241217.html) and cppa.ca.gov/regulations/cpi_adjustment.html, but neither page was read.
